limitations: GetDevice remains the upstream unknown policy; absence of a full prefixed string is not ABI evidence.
No pool registration, Metal resource, physical/virtual mapping or GPU/guest execution is introduced.
Operands require caller-owned lifetimes and exclusion of concurrent remapping; protected_copy does not promise rollback after concurrent remapping.
scope: seven statically identified MemoryPoolBuilder leaves only
semantics: Defaults preserves device and all bytes outside [8,28).
SetDevice writes 8B; SetStorage writes 16B; SetFlags writes 4B. No referenced device/backing is inspected.
GetMemory returns a 64-bit pointer, GetSize returns 64-bit size_t and GetFlags returns the original 32-bit payload. Only each actual field is read.
Normal writes use the one checked-prep registry and existing protected-copy primitive; no raw CPU fallback.

source.method: verified static NSO decompression/disassembly; no guest instruction executes
